description: Phase 2H: O2 lower-zone flow candidate (gain=0.25). Targeted O2_lower suite: 10/10 PASS across closed room, exterior-window, two-room doorway, and HVAC cases. Default OFF.

single_flag.note: Activates all three Phase 2H flags via the preset shortcut in SimulationEngine._sync_auxiliary_services().

explicit_flags.note: Equivalent to phase2h_candidate_preset=true. Use when individual flag control is needed.

effect.o2_lower: Protects lower-zone O2 in closed/HVAC rooms, allows moderate depletion after exterior opening, and applies stronger lower-zone mixing for interior doorway fire rooms.
effect.targeted_checks: 10/10 O2 lower PASS: r0 window t350/t420, closed t300/t450, two-room r0 t180/t300/t450, HVAC t180/t300/t450.
effect.default_off: Production default unchanged. Baseline reports are unaffected unless the preset or explicit flags are enabled.

validation_results.guardrails: 292/292 required PASS, 63 non-gating gaps (baseline OFF reports)
validation_results.godot_parse: RC=0 for all 4 targeted validation cases

safety_notes: Keep default OFF until broader gameplay and non-target validation are reviewed.
Targeted O2 lower checks pass with the preset; baseline OFF intentionally keeps those checks non-gating.
No rebaseline required when using this preset for experiments.

default_production.note: Production default unchanged. Preset must be explicitly opted-in per case.
